verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI provides async crawling primitives (AsyncWebCrawler, arun), multi-URL batch configuration, checkpoint/resume, retry with proxy chains, and Docker deployment with monitoring—all supportive of large-scale async scraping. However, community feedback notes users must build their own policy layer, rate limiting, and quality gates for true production-scale reliability, indicating the core library alone doesn't guarantee robust thousands-of-URL scraping out of the box.
